description: End-to-end workflow for reserving, authorizing, starting, modifying, and finalizing prepaid charging sessions for telco services (voice/data/SMS/content) including quota checks, top-ups, and error recovery.

subscriber_id.description: Unique identifier of the prepaid subscriber (e.g., MSISDN, IMSI, or internal ID)

booking_id.description: Identifier for a provisional charging reservation (booking) before final rating

session_id.description: Identifier for an active charging session (e.g., data session, call, content session)

offer_id.description: Identifier of a commercial offer or package that can be booked

wallet_id.description: Identifier of a monetary or bonus wallet belonging to a subscriber

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: search_booking_offers
functions.description: Search available prepaid booking offers for a subscriber based on service type, location, and time window.

subscriber_id.description: Target subscriber to personalize available offers.

service_filters.description: Filters for the type of service to be booked.

service_type.description: Type of service the booking is for.

roaming_zone.description: Roaming zone or country code where the session will occur.

destination_category.description: Destination rating category (e.g., onnet, offnet, international).

time_window.description: Desired start and end times for the booking.

start_time.description: Earliest desired start time for the session.

end_time.description: Latest desired end time for the session.

duration_hint_seconds.description: Expected duration of the session in seconds.

max_price.description: Maximum acceptable total price for the booking in main currency units.

allowed_billing_modes.description: Allowed billing modes for the offers.

include_promotional.description: Whether to include promotional or limited-time offers.

pagination.description: Pagination options for the search results.

functions.returns: List of matching offers, including pricing previews, eligibility flags, and pagination info.

functions.name: check_prepaid_balance_and_quota
functions.description: Check prepaid monetary balance and relevant quota buckets for a prospective booking.

wallet_ids.description: Specific wallet IDs to check; if omitted, all active wallets are checked.

include_expired.description: Whether to include expired or inactive wallets/quotas.

booking_hint.description: Optional booking hint to calculate if a tentative session is affordable.

offer_id.description: Offer ID for which affordability is being checked.

estimated_usage.description: Estimated usage metrics for the session.

message_count.description: Number of messages for SMS sessions.

include_hold_amounts.description: Whether to include already reserved (held) amounts from active bookings.

functions.returns: Structure containing wallet balances, quota buckets, any affordability analysis for the hinted booking, and hold amounts.

functions.name: create_prepaid_booking
functions.description: Create a provisional booking and reserve balance/quota for an upcoming session.

requested_session.description: Characteristics of the session to be booked.

network_node.description: Identifier of the originating network node (e.g., MSC, PGW, SMSC).

address.description: Destination MSISDN, URI, or content ID.

time_constraints.description: Temporal constraints of the forthcoming session.

usage_limits.description: Upper limits for usage under this booking.

charging_preferences.description: Preferences affecting how the booking is charged.

preferred_wallet_priority.description: Ordered list of wallet IDs or tags to use first.

block_if_partial.description: Whether to reject booking if only partial coverage can be reserved.

client_context.description: Client and correlation information for idempotency and tracing.

external_booking_ref.description: Client-provided idempotency key or correlation ID.

functions.returns: New booking ID, reserved amounts per wallet/quota, granted usage limits, and booking validity window.

functions.name: get_booking_details
functions.description: Retrieve details and current status of an existing prepaid booking.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Booking summary, status, reserved resources, associated subscriber and offer, and any requested detailed sections.

functions.name: authorize_and_start_session
functions.description: Authorize and start a real-time charging session based on an existing booking.

session_request.description: Information needed to bind the booking to a network session.

session_id.description: Client-provided session identifier; can be used for idempotent retries.

bearer_id.description: Bearer/PDN/session identifier in the network element.

initial_usage_hint.description: Optional expected usage to help allocate initial credit.

policy_overrides.description: Optional policy overrides from higher-level control systems.

max_authorized_units.description: Clamp the maximum units granted in the first authorization.

functions.returns: Session ID (if generated), authorization granted units and timers, and linkage between booking and session.

functions.name: update_session_usage
functions.description: Report interim usage for an active prepaid session and request additional authorization if needed.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for this report.

usage_breakdown.description: Optional granular breakdown per rating component.

request_additional_units.description: Whether to request more units for continued service.

max_additional_units.description: Upper bound on additional units to grant in this update.

functions.returns: Updated authorization (additional units or termination indication), current charged amounts, and remaining reserved resources.

functions.name: modify_prepaid_booking
functions.description: Modify an existing booking before or during a session (e.g., extend duration, switch wallet priority).

time_constraints.description: New time constraints for the booking.

extend_validity_seconds.description: Seconds to extend booking validity window.

functions.returns: Updated booking details, including any additional reservations or releases, and applied modification list.

functions.name: finalize_session_and_charge
functions.description: Terminate a session, perform final rating, and commit or rollback reserved amounts.

final_usage.description: Final usage metrics for the session, including last segment.

usage_segments.description: Optional detailed segments for advanced rating (e.g., roaming, peak/off-peak).

commit_strategy.description: How to handle committed vs reserved amounts on discrepancies.

functions.returns: Final charged amount, released reservations, generated transaction IDs, and rating breakdown.

functions.name: cancel_prepaid_booking
functions.description: Cancel a booking that is not needed anymore and release any reserved resources.

force_release.description: If true, release reservations even if linked to an active or unknown session state.

retain_audit_trail.description: If false, anonymize personal identifiers while retaining financial records.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, released reservations summary, and any impacted sessions/wallets.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_charging
functions.description: Handle error recovery scenarios by retrying failed charging actions or performing a controlled rollback.

recovery_action.description: Requested action to perform for error recovery.

original_request_id.description: Identifier of the failed original request if known.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate what would be changed without applying it.

functions.returns: Outcome of the recovery action, including any new or reversed transaction IDs, and state corrections performed.

functions.name: topup_and_reauthorize_booking
functions.description: Perform an immediate top-up for a prepaid subscriber and re-evaluate a failed or pending booking for authorization.

booking_id.description: Booking to re-evaluate after top-up; can be omitted for general top-up.

amount.description: Top-up amount in main currency units.

voucher_details.description: Voucher-specific information if top-up source is voucher.

auto_start_session.description: If true and booking becomes authorized, immediately start the session if network context is available.

functions.returns: Top-up result (new balances and transaction ID) and, if applicable, updated booking status and reauthorization outcome.

functions.name: list_subscriber_bookings_and_sessions
functions.description: List current and recent bookings and sessions for a subscriber with filtering and pagination.

filters.description: Filter criteria for bookings and sessions.

include_historical_days.description: Include items from the last N days if time bounds are not specified.

functions.returns: Paginated list of bookings and/or sessions for the subscriber, with summary status and optional wallet impact snapshots.

functions.name: get_charging_state_and_consistency
functions.description: Get a consolidated view of charging state for a subscriber, booking, or session and check for state inconsistencies.

consistency_checks.description: List of consistency checks to run.

functions.returns: Consolidated charging state view for the specified scope, including any detected inconsistencies and recommended recovery actions.

functions.name: search_prepaid_booking_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across prepaid_booking entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching prepaid_booking entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_prepaid_booking_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N prepaid_booking records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_prepaid_booking_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many prepaid_booking records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_prepaid_booking_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many prepaid_booking records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_prepaid_booking_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of prepaid_booking data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_prepaid_booking_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a prepaid_booking dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_prepaid_booking_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more prepaid_booking entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_prepaid_booking_snapshot
functions.description: Restore prepaid_booking state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_prepaid_booking_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the prepaid_booking workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_prepaid_booking_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across prepaid_booking metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_prepaid_booking_audit_events
functions.description: Search the prepaid_booking audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_prepaid_booking_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers prepaid_booking workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_prepaid_booking_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for prepaid_booking events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_prepaid_booking_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for prepaid_booking events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_prepaid_booking_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off prepaid_booking job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_prepaid_booking_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled prepaid_booking jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_prepaid_booking_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled prepaid_booking job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_prepaid_booking_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a prepaid_booking operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_prepaid_booking_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a prepaid_booking action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_prepaid_booking_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a prepaid_booking approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_prepaid_booking_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any prepaid_booking entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_prepaid_booking_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a prepaid_booking entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_prepaid_booking_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling prepaid_booking behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_prepaid_booking_policies
functions.description: List prepaid_booking policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_prepaid_booking_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two prepaid_booking-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_prepaid_booking_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a prepaid_booking entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_prepaid_booking_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many prepaid_booking entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
